scripts.test:rust: npm run copy && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint:rust: npm run copy && cargo fmt --check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --all-targets --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --all-targets --features e2e --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.build:e2e: npm run copy && cargo build --release --features e2e --target-dir src-tauri/target/e2e --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
